subject.title: Support compat reasoning levels for thinking xhigh

question: Should OpenClaw accept this expanded OpenAI-compatible reasoning-effort compat contract for Completions and Responses models, including mapped provider-native effort values and conservative `max` exposure?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and proven, but changing provider/model compat semantics is a public provider contract and upgrade-safety decision that automation should not approve by itself.

options.title: Accept Expanded Compat Contract
options.body: Land the PR after maintainer/provider-owner acceptance, keeping `xhigh` and mapped efforts opt-in and `max` conservative.

options.title: Narrow The Surface
options.body: Ask the author to limit the PR to the already-approved Completions or `xhigh` subset and leave Responses or mapped-effort behavior for a separate provider-contract PR.

options.title: Pause For Different API Shape
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers decide whether a different compat or plugin API should own provider-native extended reasoning efforts.

recommendation.title: Accept Expanded Compat Contract
recommendation.body: Land the PR after maintainer/provider-owner acceptance, keeping `xhigh` and mapped efforts opt-in and `max` conservative.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the closest merged configured `xhigh` compat predecessor and appears in the current-main history for the shared thinking/provider helper area.
